description: Add daily atorvastatin 20 mg as home medication
presentation: A 70-year-old man with hypertension, diabetes, left ventricular dysfunction with LBBB, prior left colectomy for diverticulitis, GERD, PUD, and a history of GI bleeding presents after a recent admission to an outside hospital for recurrent hematochezia and change in stool caliber. His home medications include daily atorvastatin 20 mg. CT angiography was normal, his vital signs and hemoglobin remained stable, so he was discharged home without further work-up. What further follow-up, if any, is recommended?
